Alex K: Quick follow-up from the FA3 integration tests — seeing weird short-sequence perf deltas on A100 pools, can anyone confirm?
Priya S: I repro'd locally on a 8-token chat workload. Throughput dropped ~8% and p95 latency increased ~15% when FA3 is selected vs our old FA2 path.
Marco T: Did you compare nvprof traces? might be kernel fusion differences or extra memcpy.
Priya S: Not yet. I captured a small timeline: kernel launch counts are slightly higher, and workspace allocs spike for sequences <32. Logs: `workspace_size=24MB -> 48MB allocs` for some batches.
Alex K: That's interesting — FA3 uses a slightly different workspace alignment for reduction kernels; could cause fragmentation when we reuse per-stream pools.
Sophie L: Also saw BF16 math instr difference on one config. FA3 toggles a different epilogue which touches atomics for partial reductions.
Marco T: If atomics are used in the epilogue, that could explain higher latency on short tokens: extra synchronization cost.
infra-bot: deploy:fa3-canary to a subset of dedicated-A100 completed (tag: fa3-canary-2026-03-19)
Alex K: @Marco can you run a micro-benchmark that toggles the FA3 epilogue flag? even a synthetic kv-cache-only run would help isolate.
Marco T: On it. Quick result: synthetic batch size 1, seq=8, toggling epilogue reduces p95 by ~12% but throughput unchanged. So epilogue sync is the p95 culprit.
Priya S: Good find. So two orthogonal problems: workspace fragmentation causing throughput hit and epilogue sync causing p95. Do we have heuristics to avoid FA3 on short sequences?
Sophie L: We have selection heuristics currently based on model size and batch. We could add a short-seq override: prefer FA2 for seq<=16 and batch<=4 on A100 until we fix epilogue.
Alex K: Agree. Also try increasing pool granularity to reduce failed-fit allocs. Marco, can you test increasing pool chunking from 8MB to 16MB in the allocator and see throughput change?
Marco T: I'll run that. Early note: bigger chunks reduce fragmentation but increase nominal memory overhead.
Priya S: We should also add telemetry flags: record selected-attention-kernel, workspace-request, actual-allocated, and epilogue-mode. That'll make post-rollout debugging easier.
Alex K: Yes, add to runtime telemetry. @Sophie can you draft the small RFC for selection rule + allocator tweak? Keep it short, just config changes and rollout plan.
Sophie L: Will do. Plan: a) short-seq override to FA2, b) bump allocator chunk to 16MB behind a kill-switch, c) enable the extra telemetry. Rollout to canary then 10% -> 50%.
Priya S: One more data point: on V100 the regression is negligible. So likely A100 SM scheduling + epilogue atomics interaction.
Marco T: Patch note: kernel launch count for seq=8 went from 12->18 with FA3 epilogue enabled. That aligns with more micro-kernels being executed.
Alex K: Ok action items: Marco run allocator chunking test and epilogue A/B timeline, Sophie write RFC, Priya prepare perf dashboards to read the new telemetry. I'll add the short-seq override to the runtime config and ship to canary.
infra-bot: incident:perf-regression created (#IR-2026-042) assigned to eng-runtime
Alex K: Thanks everyone. Keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
